comment: The output range is ±5V only with the LIM switch on; with it off the level depends on the file and the master knob. The waveform display is a custom widget with no ParamWidget, so the extra items it carries — Phase scan, Reset Cursors, Copy Cue to Loop, Copy Loop to Cue and the Presets submenu at SickoPlayer.cpp:1479-1490 — cannot be reached by clicking it for help; Phase scan and Presets also appear on the module's own menu, but Reset Cursors, Copy Cue to Loop and Copy Loop to Cue appear only on the display's menu. The 'Unlimited Sample Size (risky)' item is stored under the name unlimitedRecording (:276) although this module does not record.
